title: 1202 Program Alarm
description: Build an Intcode computer and find the noun/verb pair that produces a target output.
writeup:
## Approach

This is the first Intcode puzzle — a recurring theme throughout 2019. The computer is a simple VM with position-addressed memory and three opcodes.

## Part 1

Implement the Intcode interpreter: opcode 1 adds, opcode 2 multiplies, opcode 99 halts. Each instruction reads two values by address, computes the result, and writes it to a third address. Set `mem[1]=12, mem[2]=2` (the "1202" alarm state) and return `mem[0]` after halting.

## Part 2

Brute-force search over all 10,000 noun/verb pairs (0-99 each). For each pair, reset the program, set `mem[1]=noun, mem[2]=verb`, run to completion, and check if `mem[0] == 19690720`. The answer is `100*noun + verb`. This runs quickly since each program execution is only a few dozen steps.
